description: Bounty: Runner: radio lead-in, calls and sign-offs.

briefing: Marta Quill is trying to leave {system}. She is fast and she has guards. Do not let her reach the gate.
Quill is running. {client} would like her stopped, not chased.
Bounty on a runner. Cut her off, then deal with the guards.
success: Quill is destroyed. The bounty is yours, {captain}.
Runner stopped. {client} pays and the lane is quieter.
Quill will not be running again. Payment is on its way.
failure: Quill is through the gate. The bounty lapses.
She got away, and so did the {enemy} guards.
radio-run: Quill's courier is burning for the gate. Escorts are in your way.
There she goes. Three guards between you and her.
Target is running. Get past the escorts or through them.
radio-cover: More {enemy} ships, left. Four of them.
Quill's friends have arrived. One is a gunship.
Hostile reinforcements on the left. Keep the pressure on Quill.
